user_saw: In a new session or cron run, an MCP server without an explicit timeout could appear to have no tools when its tool list took more than 1.5 seconds.
summary: The fix raised the default MCP tool catalog listing timeout from 1.5 seconds to 10 seconds and preserved explicitly configured timeouts.
reasoning: The fix parent confirms that servers without an explicit timeout used the 1.5-second catalog limit. The fix attributes that limit to PR #85063, but the local path history fails at the shallow boundary, so I could not inspect the earlier diff or verify whether slow listings had worked before that PR.
